title: Lead Cloud Infrastructure Architect / Engineer (Azure, DevOps, Kubernetes, Terraform)
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Lead Cloud Infrastructure Architect / Engineer (Azure, DevOps, Kubernetes, Terraform)
About Mastercard  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  

  

About The Role  

Cloud Infrastructure Engineers at Mastercard design, build, and operate the foundational platforms that enable our product and service teams to deliver securely, reliably, and at scale. This role focuses on Azure\-based infrastructure, cloud\-native services, and automation that power transaction processing, analytics, developer productivity, and self\-service delivery across the enterprise.  

As a Lead Cloud Infra Engineer, you will operate as a senior individual contributor with broad technical ownership and influence that extends beyond a single team. You will drive the design and evolution of complex platform capabilities, set technical direction for key areas of cloud infrastructure, and partner closely with engineering, security, and operations leaders to ensure platforms are scalable, resilient, and aligned with business goals. While still hands\-on, your impact is measured by the systems, standards, and teams you enable.  

As a Lead Cloud Infra Engineer, you are expected to perform the following general responsibilities:  

* Provide technical leadership for complex cloud infrastructure and platform initiatives spanning multiple teams or services
* Own the architecture, design, and implementation of critical Azure infrastructure components and platform capabilities
* Define and evolve standards, patterns, and guardrails for secure, scalable, and operable cloud solutions
* Lead cross\-team technical discussions, driving alignment on design decisions and tradeoffs
* Enable and improve self\-service provisioning and developer platforms that reduce friction and increase team autonomy
* Anticipate and mitigate systemic risks related to reliability, security, scalability, and cost
* Guide and mentor Senior and Software Engineer II team members through design reviews, feedback, and technical coaching
* Partner closely with product, security, operations, and architecture stakeholders to translate business needs into platform solutions

  

All About You  

  

* Overall 8\-12 years of career experience in a similar field
* Extensive hands\-on experience designing, building, and operating Azure\-based cloud infrastructure at scale, including compute, networking, storage, identity, and platform services
* Deep expertise with Infrastructure\-as\-Code and automation, using tools such as ARM, Bicep, Terraform, or equivalent, with a strong emphasis on modularity, reuse, and policy enforcement
* Strong command of cloud security and networking concepts, including identity and access management, private networking, secure service boundaries, and defense\-in\-depth architectures
* Proven experience designing resilient, highly available, and fault\-tolerant platforms, with a strong understanding of failure modes and disaster recovery strategies
* Demonstrated ability to lead large or complex initiatives end\-to\-end, including authoring and reviewing technical designs, decomposing work, sequencing delivery, and managing safe production rollouts
* Treats operability and cost efficiency as core design principles, ensuring observability, auditing, and financial transparency are built into platform solutions
* Advanced troubleshooting skills, capable of diagnosing and resolving broad, cross\-system production issues with minimal guidance
* Strong experience with enterprise CI/CD and SDLC practices, including quality gates, change management, and automation at scale
* Clear, influential communicator able to document architectures, establish technical direction, and drive consensus across distributed teams
* Consistent track record of mentoring and elevating other engineers, raising technical quality and ownership across the team
* Pragmatic and collaborative leader who balances technical excellence with delivery needs and organizational realities
* Actively evaluates industry trends in cloud, DevOps, and platform engineering and applies them thoughtfully to Mastercard’s ecosystem

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: GCP Devops Engineer
description:
GCP DevOps Engineer

**Experience:** 6\+ Years  
**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Work Mode:** Onsite  
**Primary Cloud:** Google Cloud Platform (GCP) – 90%  
**Secondary Cloud:** AWS – 10%  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **GCP DevOps Engineer** with 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, automation, CI/CD, and containerized environments.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in **Google Cloud Platform**, which will account for approximately **90% of the role**, with around **10% exposure to AWS**.

The candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, automating, monitoring, and maintaining highly available and scalable cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a **Mumbai\-based onsite environment**.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, deploy, and manage scalable infrastructure primarily on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application build, testing, and deployment.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**.
* Manage and optimize GCP compute, networking, storage, IAM, and security services.
* Work with containerized applications using **Docker and Kubernetes/GKE**.
* Implement and manage Kubernetes deployments, services, ingress, configurations, and scaling.
* Develop automation scripts using **Shell/Bash, Python, or similar scripting languages**.
* Monitor cloud infrastructure, applications, deployments, and system performance.
* Troubleshoot production issues related to infrastructure, deployments, networking, and application availability.
* Implement logging, monitoring, alerting, backup, and disaster\-recovery practices.
* Manage source control and branching strategies using **Git**.
* Collaborate with developers, architects, security teams, and other stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to improve deployment speed, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Support AWS\-based environments and services where required.

Required SkillsGCP – Mandatory

* Strong hands\-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform**.
* **Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)**.
* Compute Engine / VM management.
* VPC, subnets, firewall rules, load balancing, and cloud networking.
* IAM and service accounts.
* Cloud Storage.
* Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging.
* Cloud Build / CI/CD.
* Artifact Registry or similar GCP container registry.
* Experience with GCP security and access management.

DevOps \& Automation

* Strong experience with **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Cloud Build**, or similar tools.
* Experience with **Terraform** or other Infrastructure as Code tools.
* Strong knowledge of **Docker and Kubernetes**.
* Git and version\-control practices.
* Linux administration and troubleshooting.
* Scripting experience in **Shell/Bash and/or Python**.

AWS – Secondary

* Basic to moderate hands\-on experience with AWS.
* Understanding of services such as **EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and EKS**.
* Ability to support or troubleshoot AWS environments when required.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working in production enterprise cloud environments.
* Experience with highly available and scalable architectures.
* Knowledge of cloud security and DevSecOps practices.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools.
* Experience with Helm and Kubernetes deployment strategies.
* Understanding of networking, DNS, SSL/TLS, and load balancing.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum development environments.
* Relevant GCP or DevOps certifications would be an advantage.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be a **hands\-on DevOps professional with strong GCP expertise**, capable of independently managing cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes environments, automation, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.

**GCP expertise is the primary requirement, with an approximate 90% GCP / 10% AWS focus.**

**Important:** This is an **onsite position in Mumbai**, so candidates must be comfortable working from the Mumbai office.

Pay: ₹1,500,000\.00 \- ₹2,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Mumbai, Maharashtra (Mumbai, Mumbai Suburban District)

title: DevOps Engineer, Production Support, CI/CD & Cloud Operations
description:
Pune, India \| Full time \| Hybrid \| R1558612


  
We are seeking a skilled and proactive DevOps Engineer with 4–7 years of experience to support and enhance the delivery, reliability, security, and operational excellence of multiple enterprise applications within Cronos area. The role involves managing deployments, production support, monitoring, infrastructure automation, security compliance, disaster recovery readiness, and continuous improvement of DevOps processes across regulated environments.


Key Responsibilities
  

* Work as the 1st level of support for all user queries and issues in Production for Cronos applications such as CIRP, REQ, RPDM, eClinRO, ePRO, etc.
* Manage and execute application deployments to UAT and Production environments for platforms such as CIRP, REQ, RPDM, eClinRO, ePRO, etc. ensuring adherence to approval and change management processes.
* Own and manage ServiceNow change requests, including change planning, tracking, execution, documentation, EIQ/AIQ activities, and audit readiness.
* Monitor application and infrastructure health through proactive monitoring, API health checks, response\-time analysis, log collection, and troubleshooting across production environments.
* Perform infrastructure administration and upgrades, including networking, VPN tunnels, certificates, CIDR management, and cloud/on\-premises connectivity in accordance with organizational standards.
* Independently execute releases and environment management activities while ensuring compliance with SDLC, validation, and regulatory requirements.
* Support validation and compliance activities by collecting and maintaining documentation required for validation packages and audit reviews.
* Manage backup, recovery, and disaster recovery processes, including periodic validation of backups, active\-active/active\-passive failover testing, and DR simulation exercises.
* Administer operating system and security patching activities, including firewall management and hardening (e.g., FortiGate or equivalent enterprise firewalls).
* Provision and maintain new application environments (Dev/Test/UAT/Prod) and ensure consistency through automation and infrastructure standardization.
* Provide L1/L2 operational support for production incidents including application outages, access issues, deployment failures, and infrastructure\-related problems.

Additional Responsibilities:
  

* Design, implement, and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent automation frameworks.
* Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines to reduce deployment duration, improve release reliability, and increase deployment automation.
* Drive migration and adoption of enterprise DevOps toolchains including GitLab, SonarQube, Jira, artifact repositories, and automated quality gates.

Required Skills \& Experience:
  

* 3–5 years of experience in DevOps, Release Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or Infrastructure Operations.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation.
* Experience with GitLab, SonarQube, Jira, and ServiceNow.
* Knowledge of Linux/Windows server administration and OS patch management.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and Azure).
* Understanding of networking concepts, firewalls, VPNs, DNS, load balancers, and SSL certificates.
* Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Datadog, Splunk, ELK, CloudWatch or equivalent.
* Knowledge of backup, disaster recovery, high\-availability architectures, and business continuity planning.
* Scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar languages.
* Familiarity with regulated environments (GxP, validation, audit compliance) is highly desirable.

Preferred Qualifications:
  

* Experience supporting healthcare, life sciences, or regulated enterprise applications.
* Certifications in AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, or DevOps\-related disciplines.
* Knowledge of containerization technologies.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Knowledge of release management process.
